architecture.mechanism: 3D printed rotating carousel that indexes sealed micro‑vials with precision XY positioning and a locking lid
architecture.intervention: Substitute the existing carousel with a 3D printed rotating carousel featuring a locking lid and stepper‑motor driven XY indexing, integrated with the peristaltic probe and barcode reader
architecture.expected_effect: Prevents mechanical jamming by providing smooth, controlled rotation and secure vial retention, delivering reliable, precise sample handling
architecture.falsification_test: Run the autosampler with a full rack of sealed micro‑vials under jam‑prone conditions; verify that >95% of injections succeed without jamming, indicating the carousel mechanism works
